items.title: United Airlines (UAL) Brings Live Sports To Starlink Seatback Screens
items.summary: United Airlines Holdings (NasdaqGS:UAL) is adding DISH Network live sports feeds to Starlink-equipped seatback screens on domestic routes. The carriers report that Starlink hardware is being installed rapidly across United aircraft, expanding ready-to-stream live TV capacity. MileagePlus members are set to receive free access to select live sports content during eligible domestic flights under the partnership. items.title: Fuel Price Surge Prompts Airlines to Cut Flights—and Keep Fares High
items.summary: Airlines are cutting money-losing flights to protect pricing power as fuel prices march higher, executives said Wednesday.  United Airlines Chief Financial Officer Mike Leskinen said United would drop some flights in December and could cut flights into next year if fuel prices stay high.  The rise in fuel prices since the start of the Iran war has undermined airline profits.

items.summary: The S&P 500 (^GSPC) is home to the biggest and most well-known companies in the market, making it a go-to index for investors seeking stability. But not all large-cap stocks are created equal - some are struggling with slowing growth, declining margins, or increased competition.
